name: Body shell, front section
function: Scaled A1 body, front third (nose to front pods)

name: Chassis plate
function: Backbone: carries hinges, legs, electronics and battery

name: Hinge mast
process: FDM print, 2 × M3 to the chassis plate
function: Ties the hinge block to the chassis plate; the body shell carries no load

name: Pod duct ring (holds the EDF)
function: Clamps the EDF casing; bell-mouth inlet lip; servo-arm boss

name: Tyre ring
process: FDM print, stretch over the duct ring

name: Pod swing arm
function: Connects the hinge shaft to the pod; swings the pod 90° up and outboard

name: Stator lamination stack, 12 teeth
function: Carries the winding; teeth sized for 1.65 T at full flux

name: Tooth coil, 10 turns Ø0.46 mm
material: Class-H magnet wire, Ø0.46 mm, varnished (with slot fill)

name: Magnet arc, N45SH, radially magnetised
process: Purchased (custom arc), bonded in the bell

name: Rotor bell / back iron
material: 4140 steel, pre-hardened 28–32 HRC (rotor bell / back iron)
function: Returns the magnet flux and spins the fan through the shaft

name: Motor shaft, Ø5 mm hardened steel, M5 front thread
Stator hub and motor mount
function: Holds both bearings; flange bolts into the fan’s motor mount

name: 90 mm 12-blade EDF fan unit: housing, stator vanes and rotor (no motor)
High-torque digital servo (35 kg·cm at 7.4 V, metal gear)
